- **Languages:** English (C2), Spanish (Native)

## About this site

A bilingual (English / Spanish) server-rendered portfolio and integrated Markdown blog. Built with Qwik + Qwik City, deployed on Vercel Edge. The site is the primary public surface for Nadya's professional identity: production web products, AI integrations, experience, education, credentials, technical stack, contact, and engineering notes.

## Positioning

Nadya builds software products enhanced with AI, not standalone AI demos. Her work connects LLM APIs and agents to React or Next.js interfaces, Node.js services, databases, external APIs, and business workflows. The focus is production-ready AI features, intelligent assistants, tool calling, orchestration, and automation that users can actually use.
